spec.why_costs: the churn sleeve is a name-level mean over swapped names and no cost multiplier can move it; the standard triple is kept because run_midmonth publishes all three arms and the era spread is read off the same burn

honest: the gap-tolerant branch repairs only integer-ratio prints inside the session limit, so a real resumption that happens to land on an integer ratio would be repaired too -- the ratio test is evidence, not proof
a wider gap limit buys more repairs and more false positives together; the sweep is published so the reader can see what each session costs
churn sleeve is an equal-weight mean over the swapped names, not a portfolio return
screen reports count repairs, not book impact: a repaired print still enters the rank cache at its adjusted level
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial count
